name: web-monochrome-3d-blob-agency-hero
title: Monochrome 3D Blob Agency Hero
whatItIs: A grayscale hero in a rounded black frame: a giant bold headline 'THE RIGHT MIND' half faded, a glossy dark organic 3D form behind it, floating service chips, a play button, three stats and carousel arrows.
whatItMeans: Without color, the form and typography carry the whole mood: sleek, intelligent, slightly mysterious. The fading top line adds depth.
techniques: Huge heavy caps with one line dimmed for hierarchy
Glossy abstract 3D object with rim light against black
Service chips floating around the object like labels
Stats row in the lower left with tiny captions
Strict grayscale with white as the only bright
bestFor: Brands wanting a premium, futuristic feel

vocabulary.definition: Light along an object's edges that separates it from the background.
Small pills placed around a visual as labels.
One text line set at lower contrast to create depth.
